label: Booking a routine check-up
message: Hi there, I'd like to book my yearly physical sometime in the next month or two. I feel fine and have no new symptoms. Could we also recheck my cholesterol at the same visit? It was a little high last year.

result.justification: Patient requests a scheduled annual physical in 1-2 months with a repeat cholesterol check for a mildly elevated result last year. No red flags or modifiers were extracted (none present), and the patient reports feeling fine with no new symptoms. Not one level higher (within_few_days) because there is no symptom or clinical concern needing a workup sooner than the routine window. Not one level lower (self_care) because booking a physical and ordering a lipid recheck requires clinic administrative and clinical action, not home care.
result.safety_net: If you develop chest pain or pressure, shortness of breath, fainting, weakness or numbness on one side, trouble speaking, or any other new or worrying symptoms before your visit, call 911 or seek emergency care right away. For milder new concerns, contact the clinic to be seen sooner rather than waiting for your scheduled physical.
result.patient_message: A Counsel physician will review your message in the standard queue. If you develop chest pain or pressure, shortness of breath, fainting, weakness or numbness on one side, trouble speaking, or any other new or worrying symptoms before your visit, call 911 or seek emergency care right away. For milder new concerns, contact the clinic to be seen sooner rather than waiting for your scheduled physical.
